custom.notes: FS wilds are RARE (own 120-stop fsReelStrips, all 5 reels). 3sc=per-spin expansion (0-5 wilds/spin, cleared each spin); 4sc=STICKY (towers accumulate, cap 5). FULL BOARD = 5 wild reels = INSTANT MAX WIN (5000x) in BOTH bonuses (fullBoardInstantMaxWin). 1-4 wilds pay natural ways. Reel 0 carries a wild (needed for the 5-tower full board). 3sc-fullboard ~1-in-75M (legendary); 4sc-fullboard ~0.5%. High volatility, base game strips unchanged.

viceBuyStages.fsStripsRule: buy3 BOUGHT round: its own 1215-stop FS strips, 42 wilds per reel. Re-fitted together with the tower multipliers. Ship the stop arrays VERBATIM — at this wild density the arrangement is a first-order lever (same multiset, different shuffle measured 96.19 / 92.47 / 90.56 / 92.61).
viceBuyStages.note: Forced 3-scatter trigger, then a per-spin-expansion free-spins round on the strips above. 1-4 wilds pay natural ways; 5 full wild reels = INSTANT MAX WIN (custom.fullBoardInstantMaxWin). No simultaneous-expansion multipliers and no full-house multiplier exist any more. Hot spins never fire on a bought round (expansion would erase the scatters the player paid for).

viceBuyStages.fsStripsRule: buy4 BOUGHT round, stage 2: its own 2406-stop FS strips, 24/16/16/16/15 wilds and 18 scatters per reel, re-fitted together with the first-spin reel-0 tower guarantee and the tower multipliers. Ship the stop arrays VERBATIM — at this wild density the ARRANGEMENT is a first-order lever (the same 22/16/16/16/15 multiset measured 95.88% in one shuffle and 99.21% in another), so they cannot be regenerated from the wild counts.
viceBuyStages.note: Forced 4-scatter trigger, then a STICKY round to towerCap 5. GUARANTEED TOWER: if the FIRST free spin would land none, reel 0 slides forward onto a wild (fires in 83.6% of rounds) — the round is sold as a tower round, so it always shows one. Reel 0 because the engine folds a column-0 wild to HIGH_A, making that tower ~10x cheaper than any other. Tower multipliers 1x-5x apply as everywhere; hot spins never fire on a bought round.

anteBet.label: 3x FREE SPINS CHANCE
anteBet.rule: Ante strips: base symbol mix scaled x8 (320 stops) carrying the extra scatters that buy the ~3x trigger chance, plus RAISED wild density (17/17/16/16/16 = 5.3% of stops vs 2.5% natural). The free spins still roll the SHARED top-level fsReelStrips, so at a locked 1-in-18 trigger the ante FS income is fixed at ~1.8x bet; the remaining value for a 3.25x price has to come from the ante BASE spins, and wild density is the only lever left once scatters are pinned by the trigger promise and the paytable is fixed.
anteBet.hotSpinDependency: The ante fit leans on hot spins roughly twice as hard as natural play: with hotSpinChance1In active it measures 96.00% (20M rounds, ±1.16pp), with hot spins disabled it drops to ~84%. If hot spins are ever dropped, the ante MUST be re-fitted. buy3/buy4 are unaffected (hot never fires on a bought round).
anteBet.certifiedBy: custom-math/sim_vice_core.mjs (live round core), seed 771177, 2026-07-28 — WITH tower multipliers. The previous 95.52%/40M figure came from a separate tool and predates the tower-multiplier mechanic, so it could not describe the shipped game: the ante draws ~64% of its RTP from the free spins, which is exactly what that mechanic changed.
anteBet.measurementNote: Per-round std is ~20x of stake. A 4M-round run carries a ±2.54pp interval — ours read 94.3% and was noise. Do not re-fit the ante off anything under ~20M rounds.

custom.towerMultiplierRule: Every reel standing FULLY WILD in a FREE SPIN is dealt a badge 1x-5x from towerMultiplierWeights. A winning ways combination pays x the HIGHEST badge among the expanded reels it CROSSES (a combo starts on reel 0 and runs matchCount reels, so it crosses reels 0..matchCount-1). Scatter pay is NEVER multiplied, and nothing is applied on top of the 5-wild INSTANT MAX WIN. HIGHEST, not the product: the product is multiplicative in tower count and measures 187% RTP on a bought 4-scatter round.
custom.towerMultiplierStickyRule: A 4-scatter STICKY tower keeps the badge it was dealt when it JOINED, for the rest of the round. A 3-scatter round re-expands from scratch every spin and therefore draws fresh badges each spin.

simResults.tool: custom-math/sim_vice_core.mjs — drives the LIVE round core (src/game/viceSpin.ts), i.e. exactly what the game pays
simResults.ruleSet: ENGINE ways evaluator (= SlotGame.sol:341, a column-0 wild folds to HIGH_A) · TOWER MULTIPLIERS 1x-5x, HIGHEST crossed badge · no simulExpandMultipliers · hot spins on (no badge)

confirmedByCore.tool: custom-math/sim_vice_core.mjs — same harness, FRESH SEED (the primary buy4 row and the independent simulator both ran on 90210; this rules out a seed artefact)

supersedes.why: The 4M run read 94.3% and was published nowhere: at a per-round std of ~20x stake, 4M rounds carry a ±2.54pp interval, so the point estimate was noise. 20M narrows it to ±1.16pp and lands on 96.00%.

simResults.invariants: credited-sum === totalWin, totalWin <= cap, no negative credits, re-derivation deterministic — ZERO violations in every run
notes: Every reel standing fully wild in a free spin is dealt a badge 1x-5x (weights 55/20/9/6/10). A combination pays x the HIGHEST badge it crosses; scatter pay is never multiplied and nothing stacks on the 5-wild instant max win.
A 5x badge reaches the board in 0.22% of natural rounds (1 in 454 spins) and 13.8% of free-spin rounds.

FIXED: the bought 4-scatter round used to finish with NO tower in 14.9% of rounds. A first-spin guarantee now nudges reel 0 onto a wild when nothing would expand (fires in 83.6% of rounds), so zero-tower rounds are 0% and every free spin of a bought round shows a tower. Reel 0 because the engine folds a column-0 wild to HIGH_A, making that tower ~10x cheaper in RTP than any other reel.
